description_target.target_text: cyan cells in grid cells spread to matching cells (exact pattern or matching row)

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         (div-rows (filter (lambda (r) 
                             (= 1 (length (unique (row g r)))))
                           (range 0 h)))
         (div-cols (filter (lambda (c)
                             (= 1 (length (unique (col g c)))))
                           (range 0 w)))
         (build-ranges (lambda (dividers total)
                         (let loop ((prev -1) (ds dividers) (acc (list)))
                           (cond
                             ((null? ds)
                               (if (<= (+ prev 1) (- total 1))
                                   (append acc (list (list (+ prev 1) (- total 1))))
                                   acc))
                             (else
                               (let ((d (first ds)))
                                 (loop d (rest ds)
                                       (if (<= (+ prev 1) (- d 1))
                                           (append acc (list (list (+ prev 1) (- d 1))))
                                           acc))))))))
         (row-ranges (build-ranges div-rows h))
         (col-ranges (build-ranges div-cols w))
         (get-pattern (lambda (r1 r2 c1 c2)
                        (subgrid g r1 c1 r2 c2)))
         (has-8? (lambda (pat)
                   (ormap (lambda (row) (ormap (lambda (v) (= v 8)) row)) pat)))
         (all-cells (map (lambda (idx)
                            (let* ((ri (first idx)) (ci (second idx))
                                   (rr (nth row-ranges ri))
                                   (cr (nth col-ranges ci))
                                   (r1 (first rr)) (r2 (second rr))
                                   (c1 (first cr)) (c2 (second cr))
                                   (pat (get-pattern r1 r2 c1 c2)))
                              (list ri ci r1 r2 c1 c2
                                    (+ 1 (- r2 r1))
                                    (+ 1 (- c2 c1))
                                    pat
                                    (has-8? pat))))
                          (positions-in-rect 0 0
                                             (- (length row-ranges) 1)
                                             (- (length col-ranges) 1))))
         (apply-cyan-for-cell
           (lambda (grid cell)
             (if (not (nth cell 9))
                 grid
                 (let* ((ri (nth cell 0)) (ci (nth cell 1))
                        (ch (nth cell 6)) (cw (nth cell 7))
                        (pat (nth cell 8))
                        (cyan-positions
                          (filter (lambda (pos)
                                    (= 8 (at pat (first pos) (second pos))))
                                  (grid-positions pat)))
	                        (candidates
	                          (filter (lambda (other)
	                                    (and (not (nth other 9))
	                                         (= (nth other 6) ch)
	                                         (= (nth other 7) cw)
                                                 (andmap (lambda (pos)
                                                   (let ((dr (first pos)) (dc (second pos)))
                                                     (= (at pat dr dc)
                                                        (at (nth other 8) dr dc))))
                                                 (filter (lambda (pos)
	                                                           (not (member pos cyan-positions)))
	                                                         (grid-positions pat)))))
	                                  all-cells))
	                        (mask-val
	                          (lambda (cand)
	                            (let* ((vals (map (lambda (pos)
	                                                 (at (nth cand 8) (first pos) (second pos)))
	                                               cyan-positions))
	                                   (u (unique vals)))
	                              (if (= 1 (length u)) (first u) #f))))
	                        (uniform-candidates
	                          (filter (lambda (cand)
	                                    (let ((v (mask-val cand)))
	                                      (and v (not (= v 0)))))
	                                  candidates))
	                        (apply-primary
	                          (lambda (gr)
	                            (let* ((target-val (mask-val (first uniform-candidates)))
	                                   (row-matches
	                                     (filter (lambda (other)
	                                               (and (= (nth other 0) ri)
	                                                    (= (mask-val other) target-val)))
	                                             uniform-candidates))
	                                   (col-matches
	                                     (filter (lambda (other)
	                                               (and (= (nth other 1) ci)
	                                                    (= (mask-val other) target-val)))
	                                             uniform-candidates))
	                                   (target-rows (remove-duplicates (cons ri (map first col-matches))))
	                                   (target-cols (remove-duplicates (cons ci (map second row-matches)))))
	                              (reduce (lambda (g2 other)
	                                        (if (and (member (nth other 0) target-rows)
	                                                 (member (nth other 1) target-cols)
	                                                 (not (nth other 9))
	                                                 (= (nth other 6) ch)
	                                                 (= (nth other 7) cw)
	                                                 (andmap (lambda (pos)
	                                                           (= (at (nth other 8) (first pos) (second pos))
	                                                              target-val))
	                                                         cyan-positions))
	                                            (paint-cells g2
	                                              (map (lambda (pos)
	                                                     (list (+ (nth other 2) (first pos))
	                                                           (+ (nth other 4) (second pos))))
	                                                   cyan-positions)
	                                              8)
	                                            g2))
	                                      gr
	                                      all-cells))))
                        (apply-secondary-rows
                          (lambda (gr)
                            (let* ((full-cyan-rows
                                     (filter (lambda (dr)
                                               (andmap (lambda (v) (= 8 v))
                                                       (row pat dr)))
                                             (range 0 ch))))
                              (if (null? full-cyan-rows)
                                  gr
                                  (let* ((same-col-cells
                                           (filter (lambda (other)
                                                     (and (not (nth other 9))
                                                          (= (nth other 1) ci)
                                                          (= (nth other 7) cw)))
                                                   all-cells))
                                         (uniform-row-vals
                                           (flatmap (lambda (other)
                                                      (let ((opat (nth other 8))
                                                            (oh (nth other 6)))
                                                        (flatmap (lambda (dr)
                                                                   (let ((row-vals (nth opat dr)))
                                                                     (if (= 1 (length (unique row-vals)))
                                                                         (list (first row-vals))
                                                                         (list))))
                                                                 (range 0 oh))))
                                                    same-col-cells))
                                         (base-val (mode-list uniform-row-vals)))
                                    (if (eq? base-val #f)
                                        gr
                                        (reduce (lambda (g2 other)
                                                  (let* ((opat (nth other 8))
                                                         (oh (nth other 6))
                                                         (matching-rows
                                                           (filter (lambda (dr)
                                                                     (andmap (lambda (v) (= v base-val))
                                                                             (nth opat dr)))
                                                                   (range 0 oh))))
                                                    (if (= 1 (length matching-rows))
                                                        (let* ((row-idx (first matching-rows))
                                                               (r (+ (nth other 2) row-idx))
                                                               (c1 (nth other 4)))
                                                          (paint-cells g2
                                                            (positions-in-rect r c1 r (+ c1 cw -1))
                                                            8))
                                                        g2)))
                                                gr
                                                same-col-cells))))))))
                   (if (not (null? uniform-candidates))
                       (apply-primary grid)
                       (apply-secondary-rows grid)))))))
    (reduce apply-cyan-for-cell g all-cells))))
racket_target.target_code:
(rule!
 ;; Uniform divider lines split the board into PANELS. A panel carrying
 ;; cyan(8) marks defines a MASK (its cyan cell positions). Same-size
 ;; panels that agree with it outside the mask and hold ONE nonzero
 ;; color under it are matches: the first match's color is the target,
 ;; and every panel in the marked panel's row/col lattice that is
 ;; target-colored under the mask gets the cyan mask stamped in. A mask
 ;; of FULL cyan rows instead stamps, in each same-column panel, the
 ;; single row made entirely of the modal uniform-row color.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (ranges-between dividers total)  ;; gaps between divider lines
       (let loop ((prev -1) (ds dividers) (acc (list)))
         (cond ((null? ds)
                (reverse (if (<= (+ prev 1) (- total 1))
                             (cons (list (+ prev 1) (- total 1)) acc)
                             acc)))
               (else (loop (first ds) (rest ds)
                           (if (<= (+ prev 1) (- (first ds) 1))
                               (cons (list (+ prev 1) (- (first ds) 1))
                                     acc)
                               acc))))))
     (define row-ranges
       (ranges-between (filter (lambda (r) (row-uniform? g r)) (range 0 h))
                       h))
     (define col-ranges
       (ranges-between (filter (lambda (c) (col-uniform? g c)) (range 0 w))
                       w))
     ;; panel = (ri ci r1 c1 pat has8?)
     (define panels
       (map (lambda (idx)
              (let* ((rr (nth row-ranges (first idx)))
                     (cr (nth col-ranges (second idx)))
                     (pat (subgrid g (first rr) (first cr)
                                   (second rr) (second cr))))
                (list (first idx) (second idx) (first rr) (first cr) pat
                      (any? (lambda (p) (= (at pat (first p) (second p)) 8))
                            (grid-positions pat)))))
            (positions-in-rect 0 0 (- (length row-ranges) 1)
                               (- (length col-ranges) 1))))
     (define (p-ri p) (first p))
     (define (p-ci p) (second p))
     (define (p-r1 p) (third p))
     (define (p-c1 p) (fourth p))
     (define (p-pat p) (fifth p))
     (define (p-has8 p) (sixth p))
     (define (p-h p) (rows (p-pat p)))
     (define (p-w p) (cols (p-pat p)))
     (define (stamp-for out marked)
       (if (not (p-has8 marked))
           out
           (let* ((pat (p-pat marked))
                  (mask (filter (lambda (pos)
                                  (= (at pat (first pos) (second pos)) 8))
                                (grid-positions pat)))
                  (same-shape? (lambda (o)
                                 (and (not (p-has8 o))
                                      (= (p-h o) (p-h marked))
                                      (= (p-w o) (p-w marked)))))
                  (agrees-outside?
                   (lambda (o)
                     (all? (lambda (pos)
                             (= (at pat (first pos) (second pos))
                                (at (p-pat o) (first pos) (second pos))))
                           (filter (lambda (pos) (not (member pos mask)))
                                   (grid-positions pat)))))
                  (mask-val
                   (lambda (o)
                     (let ((u (remove-duplicates
                               (map (lambda (pos)
                                      (at (p-pat o) (first pos)
                                          (second pos)))
                                    mask))))
                       (and (= 1 (length u)) (first u)))))
                  (matches (filter (lambda (o)
                                     (and (same-shape? o)
                                          (agrees-outside? o)
                                          (let ((v (mask-val o)))
                                            (and v (> v 0)))))
                                   panels))
                  (primary
                   (lambda (out2)
                     (let* ((target (mask-val (first matches)))
                            (target-rows
                             (remove-duplicates
                              (cons (p-ri marked)
                                    (map p-ri
                                         (filter (lambda (o)
                                                   (and (= (p-ci o)
                                                           (p-ci marked))
                                                        (= (mask-val o)
                                                           target)))
                                                 matches)))))
                            (target-cols
                             (remove-duplicates
                              (cons (p-ci marked)
                                    (map p-ci
                                         (filter (lambda (o)
                                                   (and (= (p-ri o)
                                                           (p-ri marked))
                                                        (= (mask-val o)
                                                           target)))
                                                 matches))))))
                       (for/fold ((g2 out2)) ((o (in-list panels)))
                         (if (and (member? (p-ri o) target-rows)
                                  (member? (p-ci o) target-cols)
                                  (same-shape? o)
                                  (all? (lambda (pos)
                                          (= (at (p-pat o) (first pos)
                                                 (second pos))
                                             target))
                                        mask))
                             (paint-cells g2
                                          (map (lambda (pos)
                                                 (list (+ (p-r1 o)
                                                          (first pos))
                                                       (+ (p-c1 o)
                                                          (second pos))))
                                               mask)
                                          8)
                             g2)))))
                  (secondary
                   (lambda (out2)
                     (if (null? (filter (lambda (dr)
                                          (all? (lambda (v) (= v 8))
                                                (row pat dr)))
                                        (range 0 (p-h marked))))
                         out2
                         (let* ((col-mates
                                 (filter (lambda (o)
                                           (and (not (p-has8 o))
                                                (= (p-ci o) (p-ci marked))
                                                (= (p-w o) (p-w marked))))
                                         panels))
                                (uniform-vals
                                 (flatmap
                                  (lambda (o)
                                    (flatmap
                                     (lambda (dr)
                                       (let ((rv (row (p-pat o) dr)))
                                         (if (= 1 (length
                                                   (remove-duplicates rv)))
                                             (list (first rv))
                                             (list))))
                                     (range 0 (p-h o))))
                                  col-mates))
                                (base (mode-list uniform-vals)))
                           (if (eq? base #f)
                               out2
                               (for/fold ((g2 out2))
                                         ((o (in-list col-mates)))
                                 (let ((hits (filter
                                              (lambda (dr)
                                                (all? (lambda (v)
                                                        (= v base))
                                                      (row (p-pat o) dr)))
                                              (range 0 (p-h o)))))
                                   (if (= 1 (length hits))
                                       (paint-cells
                                        g2
                                        (positions-in-rect
                                         (+ (p-r1 o) (first hits))
                                         (p-c1 o)
                                         (+ (p-r1 o) (first hits))
                                         (+ (p-c1 o) (p-w o) -1))
                                        8)
                                       g2)))))))))
             (if (null? matches) (secondary out) (primary out)))))
     (for/fold ((out g)) ((m (in-list panels)))
       (stamp-for out m)))))
